items.exampleEn: The company invested in new computers last year.
items.exampleZh: 公司去年投資購買了新電腦。

items.exampleEn: The company will pay all your travel expenses.
items.exampleZh: 公司會支付你所有的差旅費。

items.exampleEn: Education is one way out of poverty.
items.exampleZh: 教育是擺脫貧窮的一條路。

items.exampleEn: He bought his car from a dealer in town.
items.exampleZh: 他向鎮上的一家經銷商買了車。

items.exampleEn: Don't leave valuable things in your car.
items.exampleZh: 不要把貴重物品留在車裡。

items.exampleEn: My parents helped me finance my studies.
items.exampleZh: 我爸媽幫我支付學業的費用。

items.exampleEn: The buyer paid for the house in cash.

items.sentenceEn: This old painting may be very valuable.

items.audioEn: The car dealer says the price includes free repairs for the first year.
items.audioZh: 汽車經銷商說，這個價格包含第一年免費維修。
items.questionZh: 第一年有什麼是免費的？

items.sentenceEn: Keep a list of your expenses for one month.
items.sentenceZh: 把你一個月的開銷記錄下來。

items.sentenceEn: We found a buyer for our old piano.
items.sentenceZh: 我們替家裡的舊鋼琴找到了買家。

items.stemEn: She wants to ____ her money in a new business.
items.stemZh: 她想把錢投資在一個新事業上。

items.stemEn: Our biggest ____ every month is rent.
items.stemZh: 我們每個月最大的開銷是房租。

items.passageEn: Mr. Chen used to be a car dealer, but he wanted to do something different. Ten years ago, he invested most of his money in a small restaurant. To finance the restaurant, he also borrowed money from a bank. At first, rent and other expenses were high. But his food was tasty and cheap, and customers came from all over the city. Now he gives free meals to families living in poverty. He says helping others is more valuable than money.
items.passageZh: 陳先生以前是汽車經銷商，但他想做點不一樣的事。十年前，他把大部分的錢投資在一家小餐館上。為了籌措開店資金，他也向銀行借了錢。一開始，房租和其他開銷都很高。但他的菜好吃又便宜，客人從城市各地前來。現在他會送免費餐點給生活貧困的家庭。他說幫助別人比金錢更有價值。

questions.questionZh: 陳先生以前做什麼工作？
陳先生現在會為貧困家庭做什麼？

referenceEn: This fridge consumes a lot of electricity.
This fridge consumes too much power.
rubricZh: 主詞第三人稱單數用 consumes

referenceEn: This experience taught me a valuable lesson.
This experience gave me a valuable lesson.
rubricZh: 用 valuable 表示「寶貴的」（例如 a valuable lesson）
